cb3084.ex: In HIV patients with rifampicin-resistant (RR/MDR) tuberculosis, the recommended management is an all-oral, shorter regimen such as BPaLM (Bedaquiline + Pretomanid + Linezolid + Moxifloxacin) for \~6 months. * GeneXpert showing rifampicin resistance = treat as MDR-TB * BPaLM regimen is now preferred: o Shorter duration (≈6 months) o Fully oral (no injectables) o Higher success rates HIV considerations: * Start ATT immediately * Initiate ART early (within 2 weeks for CD4 <200) * Monitor for IRIS after ART initiation Why not other options: * HEZ regimens → ineffective in rifampicin-resistant TB

cb4685.ex: An elderly woman with a fall followed by a shortened, externally rotated leg most likely has a fragility fracture of the femoral neck due to osteoporosis.
